title: A worker near its turn cap commits its work in progress instead of exiting with staged changes
goal: a worker that nears its cap commits what it has on work/<id> with KB-Work and reports what is left, as the TK-ye4msgps worker (a code task: bl_land.py, an e2e test and two docs) did not at its 60-turn cap (error_max_turns, 61 turns), when its change stayed staged and the orchestrator resumed it for 10 more turns to commit and record its gate; dispatch sizes --max-turns (TURNS in bl_dispatch.py, task 60, story 100) so a code task that creates a module or edits bl_land.py, a story that measures models on paid runs and a story that only writes a report do not stop at the cap with their work uncommitted (workers used 100-122 turns in SP-dqkf3i42 and SP-x5gjv4r7); the brief states the worker's cap and the turn by which to commit

run: import re,subprocess,sys;f=lambda *a:subprocess.run(['python3','_tools/backlog.py',*a],capture_output=True,text=True,check=True).stdout;cap=int(re.search(r'--max-turns (\d+)',f('dispatch','--dry-run','ST-buzuumms')).group(1));r=f('brief','ST-buzuumms').split('## Fixed rules',1)[1].split('\n## ',1)[0];m=re.search(r'by turn (\d+)',r);sys.exit(0 if m and 5<=cap-int(m.group(1))<=30 else 1)

clauses.clause: a worker that nears its cap commits what it has on work/<id> with KB-Work and reports what is left, as the TK-ye4msgps worker (a code task: bl_land.py, an e2e test and two docs) did not at its 60-turn cap (error_max_turns, 61 turns), when its change stayed staged and the orchestrator resumed it for 10 more turns to commit and record its gate
